rows.q: Draw the Ohm's law power wheel for a lesson: P, V, I and R, each with its three formulas.
rows.why: Lantern still questions it: “fill gold”: a part line is <name>: <item> | <item> | <item>
rows.reply:
MAKE WHEEL: Ohm's Law Power Wheel
centre P V I R
P: P=VI | P=I^2R | P=V^2/R
V: V=IR | V=P/I | V=sqrt(P*R)
I: I=P/V | I=V/R | I=sqrt(P/R)
R: R=V/I | R=P/I^2 | R=V^2/P
fill gold
note Power formulas: P, V, I, R
END
